page.layout: One printed page (p. 170). Running head at top right. Running text in one full-width column. Below it: a heading block (Prælectio Sexta, title, "Continens Casus Quindecim.", SUMMARIUM.), then a numbered summary list. The right edge of the scan is cut off by the neighbouring page, so the end of the last summary line is lost. No margin notes.

main_text.p: quædam singularis & momenti & usus & indigna quæ in nimis arctum compin-gantur: illud præsertim, quonam sensu Juramentum debeat intelligi. Itaque ne aut vobis aliquam injuriam faciam nimia prolixitate, aut rei ipsi nimia brevitate; dabo operam ut proxima prælectione, cum Finali causa (quæ nec multa continet dubia, nec multum difficilia) una etiam expediam ea quæ de Interna Forma superfunt dicenda.
main_text.head: Prælectio Sexta. De Iuramenti Formâ Interna, & Causâ Finali.
Continens Casus Quindecim.
SUMMARIUM.
main_text.l: 2. Ubi de sensu juramenti inter partes constat.
